check: sha256 of every statutory text file vs the hash recorded in the signed pack
verdict: CLEAN — 21/21. The signed hashes verify against the text on disk.
why_this_matters: This is the first claim checked today that verified COMPLETELY clean. 417 provisions resolved to 21. 4 framework control-sets resolved to 4. 7 signed agents resolved to 7. 7 MCP tools resolved to 7 served. 149 models resolved to 12 distinct. 271 published tools resolved to 7. Every headline count in the estate shrank on contact with its evidence — except this one, which is exactly what it says it is.
what_it_licenses: The corpus can be cited as hash-anchored without qualification: a reader can recompute sha256 over art05.txt and match it to provisions.json. That is a real, checkable provenance property and it is rare — NIST publishes a PDF, vendors publish XLSX, neither is verifiable.
what_it_does_not_license: Size. It is 21 provisions of one framework, and that number has now been confirmed three separate ways. The corpus is small and real; the claims about it were large and unevidenced.
